_comment: Department redaction rules. Committed with the knowledge repository so every colleague inherits them. Edit block/warn/allow below; 'examples' is ignored by the tool.

numeric_host_id.name: numeric_host_id
numeric_host_id.note: Bare unit numbers cannot be told apart from ordinary quantities (16384, 65536), so they are not a built-in rule. Copy this into warn/block and list your own units.

customer_name.name: customer_name
customer_name.note: Prefer codewords and generic nouns in shared records; use block when a real name must never appear.
